scope: Deterministic project-scoped material-state baselines for the bounded Autonomous intake review receipt, evidence verification, mission-scoped official NVD detail, the Plan Recon Digital Twin desktop graph and Android mobile reduced-motion list, Guided decision, recovery, plan-amendment boundaries, Second Brain, and connected Obsidian Vault states. These records do not imply coverage of earlier intake edit controls, every option state, or Live topology visual parity; they do not imply cross-browser visual approval or release sign-off, and no human approval is recorded.

baselines.carrierTitle: connects only after a real round-trip and preserves canonical health on reload
baselines.state: A real Vault is connected only after a fresh server-side filesystem proof, remains connected after browser reload, exposes its last synchronization time plus tracked-note and review counts, provides direct synchronization controls, and makes the operator no-backup policy explicit with portable ZIP export disabled.
normalizedFields: fixture-derived zero tracked-note and review counts
